notes.title: The update that many have been waiting for!!!
notes.content:
1)Added a store where you can buy a jar of health/stamina recovery or one of 15 new swords for in-game coins.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35720803/fc5ae137d30455994cee2571dcbe9c1ea600c69c.png
2)Added 15 new swords.They can only be purchased with in-game coins.
Join our discord - https://discord.gg/Y2BJfsY
Patreon - https://www.patreon.com/GGamingDev

notes.title: New year update!
notes.content:
1)Added 1 new achievement(look for it at level 4)
2)Added snow and cap in honor of the new year (will be available from December 18 to January 10)
3)Added sword "Candy cane" (go to the game from December 18 to January 10 to get it)
4)Redesigned main menu
5)Added level selection menu, it will be available after passing the game
6)Added new animation when hitting on the run
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35720803/6065471e2001656b9ebc607c4f8b6951f8e18644.png

notes.title: Significant update
notes.content:
1)Improved levels, now it became easier to pass
2)Fixed known bugs
3)Added checkpoint at the last level
4)Accelerated the speed of the falling enemy
5)Added pause menu items: Resrart and Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35720803/556281d935d20214b82cf72105753c8fcc4267df.png
If you do not drop swords after an hour in the game, just re-enter the game.
If you find any bugs,please contact us in the community center or in the discard channel - https://discord.gg/FBTGpCZ

notes.title: Update:
notes.content:
1) Reduced enemy damage at easy difficulty level
2) Reworked some objects
3) Added auto save after each level
4) Minor improvements
Unfortunately, old saves won't work. It is better to start a new game immediately, so as not to lose progress.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
1)Added a visual effect when you collect a star or heart
2)Fixed bug on level 3 with giant
3)Added easy difficulty level(can be changed in settings)
4)Added 1 new achievement

notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
This update has brought not a few changes to the game.
1)Added 6 of swords. The sword can fall out after the beginning of the level(except training), if you have spent enough time in the game. In day can be obtain only 1 sword.
2)After completing the game you are guaranteed to get a special sword.
3)Added inventory where you can choose a sword.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35720803/27556e24c253a16a239577ac64cb2b8788e909bf.png
4)Added display of damage to the enemy.
5)Added animation for the interface.
6)IOptimization was Carried out.
7)Improved AI in enemies.
Join our discord channel https://discord.gg/qqRT4dq and write your reviews.
All preferences will be taken into account in the future.
